title: Ambient M-first signed currying under normalized reindexing
statement: Let ℓ be prime and E/ℚ_ℓ finite. Let g:X≅Y be a scheme isomorphism with ℓ invertible on both schemes and essentially small pro-étale sites. In the ambient completed-ring derived categories choose closed structures SX,SY and tensor models TX,TY. Let c be a Hom/tensor reindexing comparison normalized on Hom products, total tensor generators and their localization models. Let G be any functor equal to the specified ordinary derived reindexing functor F. Transport c through eqToIso of this equality, obtaining μ⁰:G(M⊗L)≅GM⊗GL and c⁰:GH(M,N)≅H(GM,GN). Define M-first currying τX,τY by the specified signed braidings followed by Hom-first transposition for SX,SY. For arbitrary unbounded M,L,N and b:M⊗L→N, τX((μ⁰)⁻¹;G(b))=G(τY(b));c⁰. No constructibility or completeness of the inputs is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the ordinary evaluation and transposition laws to c in Hom-first order. The tensor-generator normalization makes its square with the specified signed braiding commute on simultaneous K-flat representatives: both paths exchange the two generators and multiply by the same Koszul sign. Their localization models and K-flat resolutions extend the square to all ambient objects. Precompose the Hom-first transposition formula with this square to get M-first currying equivariance. Equality induction transports this equation along the equality-induced functor isomorphism: all equality transports become identities. The displayed source component enters internal Hom contravariantly and its target component covariantly.

theorem podReindexing_ordinary_currying
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} X.ProEt] [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} Y.ProEt]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (SX : PodReindexingCoherence.Closed l E X none)
    (SY : PodReindexingCoherence.Closed l E Y none)
    (TX : PodReindexingCoherence.Models l E X none SX)
    (TY : PodReindexingCoherence.Models l E Y none SY)
    (c : PodReindexingCoherence.Comparison l E g none SX SY TX TY)
    (G : podReindexingDerived l E Y none ⥤ podReindexingDerived l E X none)
    (h : podReindexingDerivedFunctor l E g none = G) :
    let τX := fun M L N ↦
      ((pullbackTensorBraiding (ProEt.topology X) (podReindexingRing l E X none)
        SX TX).app (M, L)).homFromEquiv.trans (SX.transpose L M N)
    let τY := fun M L N ↦
      ((pullbackTensorBraiding (ProEt.topology Y) (podReindexingRing l E Y none)
        SY TY).app (M, L)).homFromEquiv.trans (SY.transpose L M N)
    ∀ (M L N : podReindexingDerived l E Y none) (b : SY.tensor.obj (M, L) ⟶ N),
      τX (G.obj M) (G.obj L) (G.obj N)
          ((((eqToIso h).app (SY.tensor.obj (M, L))).symm ≪≫ c.tensor.app (M, L) ≪≫
            SX.tensor.mapIso (((eqToIso h).app M).prod ((eqToIso h).app L))).inv ≫
              G.map b) =
        G.map (τY M L N b) ≫
          (((eqToIso h).app ((podReindexingDerivedHom l E Y none).obj (op M, N))).symm ≪≫
            c.derived.app (op M, N) ≪≫ (podReindexingDerivedHom l E X none).mapIso
              ((((eqToIso h).app M).symm.op).prod ((eqToIso h).app N))).hom
